meaning:
1) to spurn, contemn, despise, abhor
1a) (Qal) to spurn, contemn
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to spurn
1b2) to cause to contemn
1c) (Hiphil) to spurn
1d) (Hithpolel) to be contemned
glosses: who have treated me with contempt

renderings.bsb: of those who have treated Me with contempt
renderings.kjv: neither shall any of them that provoked

elsewhere.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown…
The sin of the young men was very great before Yahweh; for the men despised Yahweh’s offering.
However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to Yahweh’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”
For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.
They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
yes, they shall be afraid of heights, and terrors will be on the way; and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire…
Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken Yahweh. They have despised the Holy…
